candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a small positive constant speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest with no persistent actuator saturation; maintain SpeedRef at the specified constant value for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall converge stably to the constant 0.1 rps reference.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a small non-zero positive reference near zero while remaining within the nominal domain.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a moderate positive constant speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest with no persistent actuator saturation; maintain SpeedRef at the specified constant value for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall converge stably to the constant 5.0 rps reference.
candidates.rationale: Represents the nominal positive constant-reference operating partition.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a moderate negative constant speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest with no persistent actuator saturation; maintain SpeedRef at the specified constant value for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall converge stably to the constant -5.0 rps reference.
candidates.rationale: Represents the nominal negative constant-reference operating partition.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking near the positive edge of the nominal speed-reference domain.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest with no persistent actuator saturation; maintain SpeedRef at the specified constant value for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall converge stably to the constant 19.9 rps reference, provided persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.rationale: Uses a value just below the stated nominal-domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking near the negative edge of the nominal speed-reference domain.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest with no persistent actuator saturation; maintain SpeedRef at the specified constant value for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall converge stably to the constant -19.9 rps reference, provided persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.rationale: Uses a value just above the stated negative nominal-domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking after changing from a low positive reference to a higher positive reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest with no persistent actuator saturation; apply each SpeedRef segment in sequence and maintain the final constant reference for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: Following the change, MotorSpeed shall converge stably to the final 10.0 rps reference, provided persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.rationale: Checks tracking in a positive-reference scenario with a reference change.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking after changing from a low negative reference to a higher-magnitude negative reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest with no persistent actuator saturation; apply each SpeedRef segment in sequence and maintain the final constant reference for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: Following the change, MotorSpeed shall converge stably to the final -10.0 rps reference, provided persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.rationale: Checks tracking in a negative-reference scenario with a reference change.

candidates.test_objective: Verify tracking of a reference that changes sign through zero before reaching a final positive value.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest with no persistent actuator saturation; apply the SpeedRef segments in sequence and maintain the final constant reference for observation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall converge stably to the final constant 8.0 rps reference, provided persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.rationale: Exercises transitions through the zero-reference state before positive tracking.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive-reference directionality at a small positive speed.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest and maintain the non-zero positive SpeedRef for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: Steady-state MotorSpeed shall be positive, matching the sign of the positive SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Checks positive sign behavior close to zero.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive-reference directionality at a moderate speed.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest and maintain the non-zero positive SpeedRef for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: Steady-state MotorSpeed shall be positive, matching the sign of the positive SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Checks the representative positive-reference partition.

candidates.expected_behavior: Steady-state MotorSpeed shall be negative, matching the sign of the negative SpeedRef.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative-reference directionality at a moderate speed.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive directionality near the nominal positive input boundary.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest and maintain the non-zero positive SpeedRef for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: Steady-state MotorSpeed shall be positive, matching the sign of the positive SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Exercises positive directionality near the stated nominal-domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative directionality near the nominal negative input boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal from positive steady operation to negative steady operation.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady operation with the first positive SpeedRef segment, then apply the negative segment and observe the final state.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall transition from the original positive direction to the negative reference direction and converge stably to the final negative reference.
candidates.rationale: Directly exercises the required positive-to-negative reversal sequence.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal from negative steady operation to positive steady operation.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady operation with the first negative SpeedRef segment, then apply the positive segment and observe the final state.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall transition from the original negative direction to the positive reference direction and converge stably to the final positive reference.
candidates.rationale: Directly exercises the required negative-to-positive reversal sequence.

candidates.test_objective: Verify a positive-to-negative reversal with different reference magnitudes.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady operation with the first positive SpeedRef segment, then apply the negative segment and observe the final state.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall transition from the original positive direction to the negative reference direction and converge stably to the final negative reference.
candidates.rationale: Checks reversal when both direction and requested magnitude change.

candidates.test_objective: Verify a negative-to-positive reversal with different reference magnitudes.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady operation with the first negative SpeedRef segment, then apply the positive segment and observe the final state.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall transition from the original negative direction to the positive reference direction and converge stably to the final positive reference.
candidates.rationale: Checks reversal when both direction and requested magnitude change.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal through an intermediate zero-speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady operation with the first positive SpeedRef segment, apply zero, then apply the final negative segment and observe the final state.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall transition through the reversal sequence and converge stably to the final negative reference direction.
candidates.rationale: Exercises an explicit zero-reference intermediate state during reversal.

candidates.test_objective: Verify repeated bidirectional reversals.
candidates.precondition: Establish each preceding steady state before applying the next SpeedRef segment and observe the final state.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed shall follow each requested direction transition and converge stably to the final negative reference direction.
candidates.rationale: Exercises both reversal directions repeatedly in one scenario.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains within the specified voltage limits for a moderate positive command.
candidates.precondition: Run the MIL simulation with the constant SpeedRef for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The observed maximum Vcmd shall be no greater than +12 V and the observed minimum Vcmd shall be no less than -12 V.
candidates.rationale: Checks voltage limitation during nominal positive operation.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains within the specified voltage limits for a moderate negative command.
candidates.precondition: Run the MIL simulation with the constant SpeedRef for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The observed maximum Vcmd shall be no greater than +12 V and the observed minimum Vcmd shall be no less than -12 V.
candidates.rationale: Checks voltage limitation during nominal negative operation.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd limitation during a positive-to-negative reversal.
candidates.precondition: Establish operation with the first SpeedRef segment, apply the second segment, and evaluate Vcmd extrema over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The observed maximum Vcmd shall be no greater than +12 V and the observed minimum Vcmd shall be no less than -12 V over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.rationale: Exercises both voltage polarities and a reversal transient near the nominal speed-reference boundaries.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd limitation under a high positive speed-reference stimulus.

candidates.expected_behavior: The observed maximum Vcmd shall be no greater than +12 V and the observed minimum Vcmd shall be no less than -12 V.
candidates.rationale: Provides a stress stimulus at the stated nominal-domain boundary while evaluating the explicit voltage limits.
